defects.title: WaiterPWA bill sheet lacks bill printing (adisyon yazdırma) functionality
defects.invariant: Waiter must be able to print a guest-facing bill (adisyon) from the phone before sending to cashier
defects.mechanism: WaiterPWA bill sheet (index.html lines 132-177, bill.js lines 1-348) has no print button or print logic; Cashier has split-payment.js:1441,1498 producing 'Bilgi Fişi' via window.print but that is cashier-side, not waiter-side; waiter needs adisyon (pre-payment guest bill) print
defects.acceptance: WaiterPWA bill sheet adds print button generating formatted adisyon for guest (not fiscal), using window.print or server-rendered print layout

limitations: Static review only; fiscal vs guest bill distinction not verified in server API; print layout/template not examined
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
